title: Group OSCORE key distribution (spec 18.8.5, a6qg gap 6)
description: Group OSCORE key distribution is entirely absent from python/src/lichen. Implement per spec 18.8.5 and vector group_oscore_key.json: pairwise wrap of group key, key_epoch counter, 1-hour grace window, epoch rollback/future rejection, membership rekey. 9/10 vectors currently UNDRIVABLE (pytest.skip with reason); only id_context composition drivable via MemorySecurityContext. After implementation, flip skips to real tests driven by the vector file.
close_reason: Group OSCORE key distribution implemented in python/src/lichen/crypto/group_oscore.py (concurrent wave session; verified, not duplicated). API: GroupKeyManager(group_id, group_key, members, time_func) with epoch/oscore_id_context()/validate_epoch()/key_valid_at()/key_for_epoch()/rekey()/distribute_current()/add_member()/remove_member(); GroupKeyMaterial dataclass; pairwise_wrap/pairwise_unwrap; GRACE_PERIOD_S=3600, EPOCH_WRAP=0xFFFFFFFF. Algorithm: pairwise wrap = deterministic-ephemeral X25519 ECDH + HKDF-SHA256 KEK/nonce + ChaCha20-Poly1305-IETF envelope (vector allows 'ECDH-ES+A128KW or HPKE'; behavioral pins are uniqueness-per-member + unwrap-to-same-key, both satisfied; literal RFC 7518 ECDH-ES+A128KW also exists in lichen.crypto.group_oscore_wrap with its own vector tests). Semantics: id_context = group_id||epoch(u32 BE); monotonic u32 epoch wrapping at 4294967295 (never-reuse invariant raises on identical material across wrap generations); 1h strict grace window on old material with bounded retention + best-effort zeroization on purge; validate_epoch accepts current/successor/grace-window predecessor, rejects rollback ('epoch_rollback') and >successor ('future_epoch_unknown'); rekey distributes to current members only; removal grants no new material (forward secrecy); new member receives only current key. Test evidence: all 10 group_oscore_key.json vectors driven by real tests in python/tests/coap/test_security_app_vector_consumers.py TestGroupOscoreKeyVectors (9 formerly-skipped flipped, 1 id_context test kept) — file runs 94 passed, 0 skips. Full coap suite: 1788 passed, 1 skipped, 3 xfailed (the known pre-existing skip + wrong-CBOR-order xfails, untouched). Crypto unit suites: tests/crypto/test_group_oscore.py + test_group_oscore_wrap.py 32 passed (covers wraps_at=4294967295 pin). Spec discrepancy noted: vector file metadata cites 'spec Section 18.6' but the section is 18.8.5 in spec/12-apps.md (line 1317); spec 18.8.5 itself only mandates out-of-band/secure-unicast distribution — epoch counter, pairwise wrap algorithm, and 1h grace come from the spec 18.8 rekeying block + the vector file, which was treated as the oracle.
